body:
Shared ingestion is now implemented in draft PR #846 (candidate 2.0.40, head 1b3ad56), with 15 existing-system relations for all 17 admitted original assets. The source API preserves literal cells, exact namespaced library/feature relationships, missingness, the complete intended panel, nominal levels and source-qualified material/protocol metadata. DIA1 and DIA2 retain different reported window definitions; no exchangeable replicate or biological concentration claim is introduced.

All five hosted Python 3.10–3.14 unit jobs, lint and docs pass on this head. Integration workflow 40183613623/job 121139728815 remains live. Focused local checks pass; full local tests have not run because the unchanged memory preflight refused. The prior stale global-catalog assertion failure and correction are retained.

The [independent canonical replay bundle](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/tree/d92606a4ec2cde5cd9f9edd255a62108203f6556/experiments/2026-10-25_0959_codex_dilution-canonical) is published with exact source/code hashes and 13 passing small checker/launcher tests. The original-source build preflight refused at 69.88 MiB free plus speculative memory versus 3 GiB required, launching no child. **Canonical materialization/replay, local full-suite validation and tested publication remain pending.** This preparation does not establish calibration quality or APC availability.

After those gates pass, the separate recipe must handle method-specific acquisition, selected/query-conditioned standard signals, missing-ID aligned states, the dose conflict and nominal versus injected amount. Nine post-isolation standards do not establish general peptide-response transfer or intracellular concentration. No biological fit was launched.
